help.faqQ1: How do I book a gym on Midmar?
help.faqA1: Browse gyms from the home page or search, open a venue you like, choose a membership package, and complete checkout while signed in.
help.faqQ2: Which categories can I book right now?
help.faqA2: Gyms are available to book today. Other categories such as padel, swimming, and restaurants appear with a "Coming soon" label until they launch.
help.faqQ3: What currency are prices shown in?
help.faqA3: All prices are shown in Saudi riyals (SAR).
help.faqA4: Add venues to compare from listing cards, then open Compare to see monthly prices, ratings, branches, and highlights side by side.
help.faqQ5: How do favorites and memberships work?
help.faqA5: Sign in to save favorite venues and view active venue memberships under your account. Checkout requires a verified account.
help.faqQ6: I'm a gym owner â€” how do I list my venue?
help.faqA6: Use "List your gym" in the menu to register as a gym owner, then create and manage listings from the owner dashboard after approval.
help.faqQ7: I forgot my password or can't sign in
help.faqA7: Use Forgot password on the login page, or register a new account if you don't have one yet. Check your spam folder for verification emails.
help.faqQ8: How can I cancel or change a subscription?
help.faqA8: Policies vary by venue. Contact the gym directly using details on the listing page, or send us a message below and we'll help route your request.
